newsitem.title: CHINA: China Assets amends investment policy.
newsitem.headline: China Assets amends investment policy.

text.p: China Assets (Holdings) Ltd said on Wednesday its board passed an amendment to its investment policy in a meeting in May allowing the company to increase its exposure to listed securities.
The proposal increased the percentage of net assets permitted in the acquisition of a trading portfolio of listed securities to 50 percent from five percent, the company said in a statement.
The change allowed the company more flexibility in adjusting the mix of unlisted and listed investments to increase trading gains in response to market changes, it said.
China Asset earlier said it had agreed to sell its entire 33 percent interest in Goodbaby Child Products Co Ltd to First Shanghai Investments Ltd for US$10 million.
The disposal would enable the company to realise a profit of about US$5.50 million, it said.
"The board intends to use the proceeds derived from the disposal for re-investment purposes in accordance with the company's investment objectives," the company added.
China Asset, an investment company, is 20 percent held by First Shanghai.
